explanation: MPU6050 on GPIO 21 (SDA) and 22 (SCL) at 0x68, powered from 3V3. Setup writes 0 to the power register 0x6B to wake it. Each loop reads six bytes from 0x3B, converts X and Y to g at the default 16384 counts per g, and calls it TILT when either exceeds 0.5 g. The LED on GPIO 13 follows through a 220 ohm resistor.
